overview.classification_source: openFDA device classification, stored in demo/company/evidence/IYN.json
overview.intended_use: An imaging system used by trained operators to acquire images that clinicians then read. (Simulated intended use.)

inputs.text: Acquire images at the stated resolution across the full field of view
Meet electrical safety and EMC limits for hospital use
Stop acquisition within 1 s when the operator presses stop
Label every image with the acquisition settings

hazards.control: Hardware output limit independent of software; tested limits
Daily quality-control phantom check; artefact warning on screen
Shielding and filtering; tested to IEC 60601-1-2

problems.change: Added a ferrite on the display cable and a shielding gasket on the rear panel (design change DC-21).
